title: Go or No-Go
tagline: Fire warning on the take-off roll at Heathrow.
history: Inspired by the many take-offs where an engine fire or failure struck on the roll: the rule — reject before V1, continue after it — is drilled in every simulator check because a late or hesitant decision is what turns them into accidents.
situation: Heavy, full of fuel and 174 passengers, you are rolling on Heathrow's runway 27R. V1 today is 140 kt. Somewhere on the roll the fire bell is going to ring.
failures: Engine 1 fire during the take-off roll
tips: Below V1: thrust levers idle, reversers (T), maximum braking (B), speed brakes
Above V1: continue, fly the aircraft, then the fire drill (O → Systems: fire handle, agent)
Keep it on the centreline with the rudder

do.note: ATC: Fire service on the way to you.

objectives.text: Below V1: thrust idle within 3 s
Bring it to a stop on the runway
